ctgov.note: No P1/P2/P3 drug trials; company is a surgical robotics medical-device developer.

commercial_product.description: Next-generation single-port robotic surgical system with two human-equivalent robotic arms (nine degrees of freedom each, 28 sensors per arm) and a high-performance stereoscopic camera, designed for minimally invasive soft-tissue abdominal and gynecological surgery.
commercial_product.regulatory_status: Pre-commercial. Company plans to file a De Novo classification request with FDA for use in ventral hernia procedures as the first indication; no FDA clearance or authorization to date per FY2025 10-K (filed 2026-03-09).
commercial_product.active_clinical_studies: None disclosed in 10-K pipeline section; no IDE pivotal study currently registered on ClinicalTrials.gov.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Pure surgical-robotics medtech company. Lead asset (Vicarious Surgical System) is a pre-commercial Class II/III medical device pursuing FDA De Novo for ventral hernia; no proprietary drug clinical pipeline and no active company-sponsored IDE pivotal study disclosed in FY2025 10-K.
